preconditions.description: The number of routers n must be between 2 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] < i + 2 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The list p must contain n-1 integers, each representing a valid connection index.

postconditions.description: The output must be the path from router 1 to router n as a space-separated string.
The path must start with router 1 and end with router n.
All elements in the path must be distinct.
